label: b2-check-R2
text:
Node check-R2 (2 of 12): write the check of R2 as the executable /opt/enforce/checks/R2: `/opt/enforce/checks/R2 <file>` exits 0 when the file follows the rule, and otherwise exits 1 and prints each violation: R2, where (the file and line, or the part of the text), and what to change. By the route: A regular expression that finds text the rule forbids and replaces it, so the result follows the rule without a second attempt. Check: a regular expression that replaces what the rule forbids, so the result follows it; the mechanism must be able to write the target at that moment (or refuse the action and give the fixed text back) It reads An assistant response or a message from the agent. Where: the agent's reply exists only inside the agent framework: its hook at the end of the turn gets it, and its transcript keeps it (a file in the agent's home).
Done when: as the agent, it exits 1 and names R2 for every file in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R2/flag, and exits 0 for every file in /opt/enforce/fixtures/R2/pass. The harness checks this when you reply.
